-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem etcdstart.isRespChan_of_etcdWatchChan [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] [EM : EtcdModel
    GF] (ch : Loc) (γ : EtcdWatchNames) (pfx : GoString) : isEtcdWatchChan ch γ pfx ⊢
    etcdstart.isRespChan ch γ (watchRespOk pfx)

def etcdstart.respElemOk (γ : EtcdWatchNames) (Ok : etcdstart.RespOk GF) (i : Int) (v :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ r c c', respAt v r ∗ monoListIdxOwn γ.cur i.toNat c ∗ monoListIdxOwn γ.cur (i.toNat + 1) c' ∗ Ok c c' v r)

def etcdstart.stateCmpOk (γk : KVNames) (o : OpFull) (Q : KVState → IProp GF) : etcdstart.RespOk GF
    :=
  iprop(etcdstart.stateOk o Q c c' v r ∗ cmpOkOf γk v.CompactRevision')

theorem etcdstart.stateOk_closeErr (o : OpFull) (Q : KVState → IProp GF) (c c' : w64) (v :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse) (r : RespModel) : etcdstart.stateOk o Q c c' v r ⊢
    go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.statusErrOk v.closeErr'

def etcdstart.RespOk.{u_1} (GF : BundledGFunctors) : Type u_1 :=
  w64 → w64 → go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse → RespModel → IProp GF

theorem etcdstart.respChan_recv_au (ch : Loc) (γ : EtcdWatchNames) (Ok : etcdstart.RespOk GF) (n :
    Nat) (cursor : w64) (Φ : go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse → Bool → IProp GF) : ⊢
    etcdstart.isRespChan ch γ Ok -∗ £ 1 ∗ £ 1 -∗ etcdWatchConsumer γ n cursor -∗ (▷ ∀ v ok, (if ok =
    true then |==> ∃ r c', respAt v r ∗ Ok cursor c' v r ∗ etcdWatchConsumer γ (n + 1) c' else ⌜v =
    zero_val go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse⌝) -∗ Φ v ok) -∗ recvAu γ.spsc.chanName
    go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse Φ

theorem etcdstart.isRespChan_of_state_cmp (ch : Loc) (γk : KVNames) (γ : EtcdWatchNames) (o :
    OpFull) (Q : KVState → IProp GF) (Au : IProp GF) : (isSpsc γ.spsc ch (watchStateElemP γk γ o Q
    Au) fun x => iprop(True)) ⊢ etcdstart.isRespChan ch γ (etcdstart.stateCmpOk γk o Q)

def etcdstart.stateOk (o : OpFull) (Q : KVState → IProp GF) : etcdstart.RespOk GF :=
  iprop(∃ σ, □ Q σ ∗ watchStateRespOk o σ c c' v r)

theorem etcdstart.isRespChan_of_state (ch : Loc) (γk : KVNames) (γ : EtcdWatchNames) (o : OpFull) (Q
    : KVState → IProp GF) (Au : IProp GF) : (isSpsc γ.spsc ch (watchStateElemP γk γ o Q Au) fun x =>
    iprop(True)) ⊢ etcdstart.isRespChan ch γ (etcdstart.stateOk o Q)

theorem etcdstart.stateOk_persistent (o : OpFull) (Q : KVState → IProp GF) (c c' : w64) (v :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse) (r : RespModel) : Persistent (etcdstart.stateOk o Q c
    c' v r)

theorem etcdstart.isRespChan_persistent (ch : Loc) (γ : EtcdWatchNames) (Ok : etcdstart.RespOk GF) :
    Persistent (etcdstart.isRespChan ch γ Ok)

def etcdstart.isRespChan (ch : Loc) (γ : EtcdWatchNames) (Ok : etcdstart.RespOk GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ P, (isSpsc γ.spsc ch P fun x => iprop(True)) ∗ □ ∀ i v, P i v ==∗ etcdstart.respElemOk γ Ok i v)

theorem etcdstart.wp_respChan_receive [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] (ch : Loc) (γ :
    EtcdWatchNames) (Ok : etcdstart.RespOk GF) (n : Nat) (cursor : w64) : ⊢ ∀ Φ,
    etcdstart.isRespChan ch γ Ok ∗ etcdWatchConsumer γ n cursor -∗ (▷ ∀ v ok, (if ok = true then
    |==> ∃ r c', respAt v r ∗ Ok cursor c' v r ∗ etcdWatchConsumer γ (n + 1) c' else ⌜v = zero_val
    go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse⌝) -∗ Φ (intoVal v, intoVal ok)) -∗ WP ((chan.receive
    go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse.ty) (intoVal ch)) {{ Φ }}
